_about: Option text for yes/no questions, read only by the Vega wrapper when VEGA_YES_NO_TEXT=1. Without it vegaml shows the generic options 'no - the statement does not hold' / 'yes - the statement holds'. Keyed by question id; each entry follows the answer key's definition of that question.

is_urgent.true: there is a hard deadline or same-day need: it must be fixed today or by tomorrow, or it is blocking work right now
is_urgent.false: no deadline: at most a polite wish for a reply soon or in the next day or two

refund_requested.true: the customer explicitly asks for money back or for a charge to be refunded
refund_requested.false: the customer does not ask for any money back

churn_risk.true: the customer threatens or is considering leaving, cancelling or switching to a competitor if things do not improve
churn_risk.false: no threat to leave; a plain, already-decided cancellation request with no threat also counts as no

is_spam.true: unwanted mail the recipient never asked for: bulk advertising, a scam or a phishing attempt
is_spam.false: mail the recipient expects or would want: personal, work, transactional, a genuine security notice or a newsletter they subscribed to

is_phishing.true: impersonates a trusted party (bank, service, colleague, IT, courier, tax office) to get passwords, payment details, personal data or codes, or to open a malicious link or attachment
is_phishing.false: does not impersonate a trusted party to steal data; ordinary spam, a scam from an unknown sender, and legitimate mail are all no
